items.title: Flex Unveils Axiom As Its AI Infrastructure Spin-Off
items.summary: Flex Ltd. (NASDAQ:FLEX) on Tuesday unveiled Axiom Solutions International Inc. as the name of its planned independent cloud and power infrastructure company. The move advances Flex’s plan to separate the fast-growing business into a standalone public company.
